_readme: Audit trail of implemented IP improvements. Each release lists every recommendation (from the owner IP analysis) and every improvement idea (content/ip-backlog.json) it implemented, what changed, and how it was verified. lib/ip-autopilot.js records each one in the owner review as planned, then done, from this file. Append new releases; never edit a past one.

items.text: The .LLab Leadership Infrastructure Strength Map™ is heavily weighted to Foundations. Consider balancing the other phases.
items.change: The .LLab Leadership Infrastructure Strength Map™: added 2 prompts written for this IP (1 Internal Operating Systems, 1 Preservation); placed 5 existing prompts in the phase each belongs to; added a four-phase build guide (deliverable and how to put it to work in each phase); prompts per phase now 10 / 5 / 4 / 4.

items.text: The .LLab Mission & Values Charter™ has no prompts for Internal Operating Systems or Preservation. Every Co.LLab™ IP should carry The IV Phases™ through to Preservation.
items.change: The .LLab Mission & Values Charter™: added 4 prompts written for this IP (1 Infrastructure Planning & Management, 3 Preservation); placed 5 existing prompts in the phase each belongs to; rewrote 6 bare labels or long prompts as guiding questions; added a four-phase build guide (deliverable and how to put it to work in each phase); prompts per phase now 16 / 4 / 3 / 3.

items.text: The .LLab Mission & Values Charter™ has 6 prompts that are bare labels (for example "Our mission in one sentence:"). Add a guiding question so members know what a strong answer looks like.
items.change: The .LLab Mission & Values Charter™: added 4 prompts written for this IP (1 Infrastructure Planning & Management, 3 Preservation); placed 5 existing prompts in the phase each belongs to; rewrote 6 bare labels or long prompts as guiding questions; added a four-phase build guide (deliverable and how to put it to work in each phase); prompts per phase now 16 / 4 / 3 / 3.

items.text: The questions across all guided IP reach Nonprofits in only 2 prompts. That Omnidirectional Enterprise™ direction is under-served by the IP itself.
items.change: New prompts across the IP now reach nonprofits, volunteers and donors (33 prompts, up from 1; 20 without the new Diagnostic editions), and the Diagnostic has a Nonprofit Edition.

items.text: Internal Operating Systems has the fewest guided prompts across all IP (153). Consider whether the IP goes as deep there as in the other phases.
items.change: Guided prompts per phase across all IP are now 343 / 241 / 220 / 228 (were 358 / 163 / 150 / 152): Internal Operating Systems rose from 150 to 220 (198 without the two new Diagnostic editions). The audit now flags phase depth only when the thinnest phase is under half the deepest.

items.text: One Legacy Statement per member
items.change: One Legacy Statement per member in the Member Portal™, drafted from their own finished-quest answers in The IV Phases™, editable, saved privately and downloadable as a PDF.

items.text: Phase Readiness view in the portal
items.change: Phase Readiness panel in the Member Portal™ totals the phase map of every finished quest and names the strongest and thinnest phase.

items.text: 30, 90 and 365-day commitment check-ins
items.change: Every quest commitment comes back at 30, 90 and 365 days: a daily email when one is due and a one-click answer in the portal (kept, in progress, changed, not yet); the owner sees anonymous counts per IP.

items.text: Team mode: several leaders, one quest
items.change: Team mode on every quest: start a team, invite colleagues by email, each answers in their own account, accepted members see where answers differ; consent-based (accept to share, leave any time).

items.text: Industry editions of the Diagnostic
items.change: Nonprofit Edition and Small Enterprise Edition of the Diagnostic, unlocked by the Diagnostic, each tied to its Omnidirectional Enterprise™ direction.

items.text: Facilitator guide for running a quest with a team
items.change: Team Quest Facilitator Guide page, written for The .LLab Foundation Strength Snapshot™ and linked from team mode.

items.text: Public changelog: what changed because of member feedback
items.change: Public What Changed page and changelog feed; marking member feedback done with a public note publishes the note only (never the member or their words).

items.text: A free Succession quest
items.change: The .LLab Succession Quest™: a free quest for every signed-in member, drawn from the Knowledge Transfer Checklist™ and the Continuity Quick-Check™, in all four phases.

items.text: Introductions between collaborating enterprises
items.change: Request an introduction on any listing that opts in; the request goes to the listing owner by email (their address is never shown) and each introduction is counted.

items.text: The .LLab Collaborating Enterprises filters by Omnidirectional Enterprise™ direction
items.change: The .LLab Collaborating Enterprises now filters by all nine Omnidirectional Enterprise™ directions (Products & Services added), plus category, introductions, member offers and successor or apprentice flags.

items.text: Member-to-member offers
items.change: Listings can carry an optional member offer with terms the member writes, shown only to signed-in members; published offers are counted.

items.text: Connect The .LLab Collaborating Enterprises to Impact and community partners
items.change: Nonprofit & Community category with skill and volunteer requests, and its own filter.

items.text: Successor and apprentice matching
items.change: Optional Seeking a successor and Seeking an apprenticeship flags on listings, with filters.

items.text: An annual Omnidirectional Enterprise™ report
items.change: Introductions and member offers are counted from now on (by year and direction, counts only), shown in the owner review as the data for the annual Omnidirectional Enterprise™ report.
